parsed.name: Galil多轴运动控制器
parsed.description: 这是一类用于控制多轴电机运动的运动控制器，可驱动实验中的线性平台、位移轴或机械机构，并提供数字/模拟I/O接口用于联锁、触发和信号读取。它常用于精密定位、自动扫描、样品移动和实验装置集成控制。
parsed.description_en: This is a multi-axis motion controller used to drive motorized stages, translation axes, or other laboratory mechanisms, while also providing digital and analog I/O for interlocks, triggering, and signal readback. It is commonly used for precise positioning, automated scanning, sample movement, and integrated instrument control.
